name: Interactive Cat
description: Black cartoon cat with a swinging, bobbing body whose eyes follow the mouse cursor, drawn entirely in CSS on a solid colored background.
contents: Cat figure with ears, eyes, pupils, whiskers, collar, tag and tail
behavior: Body swings and bobs with a soft blur in an endless alternating animation
Pupils follow the mouse cursor across the document
editableByProps: Background, body, collar, tag, ear, eye and pupil colors
Swing speed, angle, bob height and blur
Mouse tracking on or off and pupil travel distance

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the cat shape or add features

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Listens to mousemove on the document and removes it on unmount
